newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says PSBR consistent with forecasts.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says PSBR consistent with forecasts.

text.p: The British Treasury said the December PSBR of 2.119 billion stg was entirely consistent with its own forecasts for full-year borrowing in the budget.

"As expected, borrowing in December was boosted by over one billion pounds due to shifts in the timing of interest payments," a Treasury spokesman said. "PSBR in December is entirely consistent with the budget forecast."
The cumulative deficit for April to December was 16.136 billion stg compared with a governnment forecast for the year to April 5, 1997 of 26.4 billion stg.
